def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t0.view((4, 6))
    idx2 = torch.tensor([1], device=t0.device)
    t0.index_fill_(0, idx2, -4)
    v3 = t0.flatten()
    t1.copy_(v3)
    v4 = v3.unfold(0, 10, 10)
    v1[t2 > 1] = -1
    t2.sub_(v1)
    v3[:] += -3
    return (v4, t0, t0, v3, t0, v4, lst, dct)
